status: CALCULATED DESIGN BUDGET; FIRST-BOARD QUALIFICATION PENDING
input: 24V nominal, regulated +/-10%, >=2A source available; common ground

precision_logic_rail.additional_external_capacitance: Display connector and supervisor bypass capacitors, plus GIGA interface decoupling; panel internal capacitance is unspecified.
precision_logic_rail.thermal_qualification: Solder exposed pad; ground copper and external thermal stitching. Qualify <=55C enclosure ambient at 0.45A. JEDEC thetaJA is an estimate, not a measured board thermal result.

backlight_rail.regulator: TSR 2-2433; independent from precision logic supply
backlight_rail.ripple_limit_status: The retained TSR2 datasheet gives a typical value, not a guaranteed maximum. The negative ripple allowance is a design assumption to qualify.
backlight_rail.unknown_panel_capacitance: Included in the 900uF limit; first-board check.
backlight_rail.qualification: Measure PWM/load-step behaviour. The converter transient bound can cross the 3.07V supervisor threshold; verify no retriggering at requested brightness. Hardware inhibits the panel rather than relying on operation during undervoltage.
backlight_rail.supply_voltage_decision: 3.3V retained: the panel connector table does not authorize 5V at these contacts.

sequencing.supervisor: Two TPS3808G33DBVR, one per rail, open-drain outputs wired AND
sequencing.delay_configuration: 100k from CT to +3V3_PANEL; VDD and MR tied to +3V3_PANEL, ensuring supervision remains valid whenever the gates are powered
sequencing.gating: SN74LVC08A AND gates PWM, STANDBY, TFT_RESET_N and TOUCH_RESET_N with READY; 10k output pull-downs.
sequencing.host_ready: FFC GIGA.10 -> display.71; AXC1 isolation -> PI1 / D70, pull-down when absent.
sequencing.firmware: Rendering continues without panel power. Return of READY repeats reset/standby delays; backlight waits 200ms after standby release and then for a valid scan boundary.

limitations: No physical panel is connected. Static arithmetic and component specifications do not establish transient or thermal qualification.
Backlight maximum current and contact sharing are unspecified by Smartwin; measure full brightness and remain within every 0.3A contact rating.
Both rail ramps, brownout/recovery, temperature, ripple and full-brightness current are first-board acceptance measurements.
No certified surge/EMC claim is made.
